notes.title: Return to Sender Update | April 20th
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, a few changes and improvements have been made for Return to Sender
[list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[*]Drone ally no longer starts at the player's spawn
[*]Drones no longer use shot sound from the vise upgrade
[*]Morris can now parry his own shots
[*]Vending machine properly scales to sound volume
[*]Enemy grenades picked up with the magnet gun no longer explode on enemy contact
[*]Return label upgrades no longer count towards Humphrey's first free item
[*]Time Challenge for each character is now 20 minutes

[h2]Content Added[/h2]
[*]Added attachments as item drops for weapons
[*]New stamp type - First Flight
[*]New weapons - Ice cube pelter, MP5, Compact 40mm, Piano gun, tape roller
[*]New upgrade - Straight razor

[/list]

Thanks!
